Vanessa / Neha / Team,

Thanks for the details. Quick guidance from a finance/control perspective:

1) Classification: For a promotional trial credit tied to product usage, standard treatment is to issue a credit memo recorded to contra-revenue (GL 6405 - Sales Promotions / Contra Revenue) unless there is an explicit requirement to record as a marketing expense. This preserves invoice trail for revenue recognition.

2) Mechanics: Because the customer is asking for the credit to be applied to Invoice 3421, we should:
   - Create Credit Memo CM-2026-0789 referencing Invoice 3421.
   - Post the credit memo to contra-revenue GL 6405 and mark as non-taxable (promo adjustment).
   - If Invoice 3421 is already paid, we will issue the credit memo and generate either an accounts-receivable credit or discuss cash refund with Accounting.

3) Approval threshold: Credits > $5,000 require a written sales approval and a CS manager sign-off. Vanessa, your email plus Sarah's reply should suffice; please confirm CS sign-off (Marissa).

4) Documentation & audit: We need the signed promo_credit_request_form.xlsx attached to the credit memo. Also capture the HubSpot deal id (HB-2026-4589).

Next steps: Neha, can you prepare CM-2026-0789 and advise the posting date? I will confirm GL mapping in our system and route the journal entries. If you'd rather classify as a marketing expense, note it will require a different JE and will not reduce gross revenue.

Marcus Lin
Accounting Manager | Redwood Inference
